items.headline: Lemfi moved millions across borders. Spending it required another bank. I designed the card feature to close the gap.
items.problemBody:
Lemfi is a fintech built for the global diaspora: cross-border transfers, multi-currency accounts, and a platform that helps people keep money moving between continents.

Moving money to Lemfi was solved. Spending it was not. We designed a card experience that closed the gap.

Raised through the card feature strategy, a new revenue stream

caseBlocks.alt: Lemfi debit card and app hero

caseBlocks.label: Intro
caseBlocks.body:
Lemfi is a fintech built for the global diaspora: cross-border transfers, multi-currency accounts, and a platform that helps people keep money moving between continents.

The people using it had left their home countries for the UK, the US, and Canada. They were sending money to family, managing balances in multiple currencies, and building lives in new cities.

Moving money to Lemfi was solved. Spending it wasn't. We designed a card experience that closed the gap.

caseBlocks.alt: Lemfi card home experience — say goodbye to fees

caseBlocks.label: Problem
caseBlocks.body: Sending money back home when you live in London. You have to enter your Barclays card details every single time. Trying to pay a friend back and finding out they needed to be on Lemfi too, or it wasn't happening. Hitting a card limit error you didn't understand, shown before you'd even tried to save a card.

caseBlocks.alt: Lemfi send method and funding flow

caseBlocks.label: Voice of the customers
caseBlocks.body: These were people describing the exact problem we knew existed.

caseBlocks.alt: Lemfi physical and virtual card screens

caseBlocks.label: Solution
caseBlocks.body: We focused on reducing spending-related complaints, onboarding a new cohort of card users, and opening a new revenue stream while making the card feel like a natural extension of the remittance product.

caseBlocks.label: Pivot
caseBlocks.body: We first introduced fees, which was derailing people. So we decided to take and chunk the process.

caseBlocks.alt: Lemfi card benefits and control screens

caseBlocks.label: Solution
caseBlocks.body: The product remembered funding methods, made peer payments work beyond the Lemfi network, and surfaced card limits before people hit a wall — so spending felt as reliable as sending money home.

caseBlocks.summary: The card design received strong positive feedback for its look and feel. Brand loyalty strengthened. Transaction volume increased significantly in the UK market following launch.

metrics.text: Fewer customer complaints across platform related to spending, target was 45%
The number of new users onboarded to the card feature jumped, the target was 30K
Raised through the card feature strategy, a new revenue stream

caseBlocks.label: Reflection
caseBlocks.body: The card feature made Lemfi feel more complete for people living across borders. It reduced friction around spending, strengthened trust in the product, and showed how tightly product design and business growth could reinforce each other.
